trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: The Games Wiki GTA VI trophies
trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment your 54th trophy does, so treat it as the finish line, not a goal of its own. Work the roadmap in order: clear the story first, then sweep strangers and robberies, and grind out the percentages on a post-game save. Guard Positive Mental Attitude along the way — it is the one trophy on this board that can slip away permanently.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: This is the on-rails opener, so there is nothing to get wrong. Play through the fishing trip that starts the game and the trophy arrives with the mission's closing scene. Enjoy the quiet pace — it is the last calm moment the story hands you.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story chapters award their trophy the instant the chapter's last mission wraps. No side objective is gated behind it, so play at whatever speed suits you. Before moving on, spend a little time in the chapter's open areas — some early markers are worth clearing while they are fresh.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Keep pushing the required missions and Chapter 2 closes itself out. Optional objectives here cannot be failed permanently, so there is no reason to replay anything. Grab any map markers you pass; the chapter's territory shrinks once the story relocates you.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 3 mission chain and the trophy pops with the chapter card. Nothing in this stretch is score-based, so take the missions as they come. Vice City opens up properly here — a good moment to start banking exploration while the plot runs.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: Output Lag GTA VI trophy roadmap
trophies.guide: Chapter 4 ends when its final mission does, and the trophy follows automatically. There are no special conditions to satisfy. If you are tracking percentages, do any cleanup in this chapter before the finale, since the map narrows afterward.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: The Games Wiki GTA VI trophies
trophies.guide: The finale is a long, multi-stage mission and the only gold story trophy, so save before committing to it. If you still want clean runs at any combat or stealth trophies, take those first. Roll credits and the whole state stays open for everything left on your list.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a standard story mission with no bonus conditions attached. See it through any way you like and the trophy is yours. It arrives early enough that failure only costs a checkpoint restart.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
sources: Output Lag GTA VI trophy roadmap
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is one of the story's bigger set pieces. Complete it to collect the trophy, and don't sweat the approach — every viable route through the heist counts. It is a good warm-up for the freeroam vault scores later.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play and this unlocks with the rest of the story trophies. Nothing extra is required, and it cannot be skipped past — the story will not advance without it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
sources: Output Lag GTA VI trophy roadmap
trophies.guide: Headliners is a mid-story mission with a loud finish. Complete it and the trophy registers immediately. There are no optional medals here, so drive the objective rather than chasing style.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown awards this trophy on completion, no conditions attached. The airport sequence is scripted, so follow the beats and the trophy follows you. Any deaths simply restart from the mission checkpoint.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
sources: The Games Wiki GTA VI trophies
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is one of the later missions — finish it and the trophy lands with the mission-complete banner. Nothing here can be permanently missed. Bring heavy weapons if you have them; the mission allows it and rewards it.

trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: Output Lag GTA VI trophy roadmap
trophies.guide: Full completion tracks every exploration marker, collectible and activity counter in the state. Use the pause-menu completion checklist to see exactly what is short, and leave this for a post-game save when the whole map is open. Chip away region by region instead of hopping between activity types at random.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: Output Lag GTA VI trophy roadmap
trophies.guide: Stunt markers are scattered across the whole state, and 250 clears most of them. Chase them while you are already traveling for other trophies; the minimap flags a stunt when one is near. A crashed attempt resets the jump, not your running total.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: There are nine activity types and you need one round of each. The map legend shows every activity icon, so plan a single tour of Vice City that touches them all. It is a short errand — worth doing early rather than during your percentage cleanup.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
sources: The Games Wiki GTA VI trophies
Output Lag GTA VI trophy roadmap
trophies.guide: All 42 range challenges want gold, and the later tiers demand tight groups and fast target swaps. Warm up each weapon family before you commit to a scored run, and buy the best variants first. This is the most mechanical trophy on the board — budget a few separate sessions for it.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Each race sends a drone through floating checkpoints, and all 14 layouts need a win. Do a throwaway lap of each course to learn the corners, then race it clean — second place banks nothing. New locations unlock as the map opens, so recheck the map after each chapter.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: The count is 20 distinct events, not 20 runs of your favorite. Street, off-road and water races all qualify, and each event tracks whether you have already beaten it. Standard difficulty is enough — no need to sweep the hardest settings.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
sources: Output Lag GTA VI trophy roadmap
trophies.guide: Once Cal's marker is on your map, take his challenge and out-fish him at his own spots. Reel with steady tension and answer the prompts instead of mashing. A loss costs nothing but time, so retry until the fish cooperate.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Arcade cabinets sit inside bars and shops around Vice City. Feed one a credit, survive a full game of any title, and this pops on the results screen. It is among the cheapest trophies on the list, so grab it the first time you walk past a machine.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's strand runs through a handful of short encounters before the closing mission. Answer his marker every time it reappears and the trophy unlocks with the strand's final scene. The missions are brief, which makes this an easy strand to slot between story chapters.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
sources: Output Lag GTA VI trophy roadmap
The Games Wiki GTA VI trophies
trophies.guide: Kenton's storyline ends with a finale that pays out this trophy. Keep responding to his marker whenever it surfaces; strands left half-done are how this one gets forgotten. Nothing in the strand is missable — it waits for you on a post-game save too.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's arc wraps with a solo run and a last mission; complete it for the trophy. The earlier beats are quick escort-and-explore jobs. If his marker stops showing up, advance the main story — some strands only move between chapters.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight full strands is the bar, and the state offers more than that, so there is slack to spare. Fold one or two stranger missions into every chapter to stay ahead of the count. The pause menu lists finished strands, so you always know how many are still owed.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's strand closes on a supply-run finale. See it through and the trophy is banked. His markers cluster in one region, so the whole strand clears comfortably in a single sitting.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
sources: Output Lag GTA VI trophy roadmap
trophies.guide: Tyrone's last mission is the payoff of his strand and the trigger for this trophy. His jobs lean hard on vehicles, so keep something fast in the garage before starting. Everything in the strand is replay-safe if a chase goes wrong.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
sources: The Games Wiki GTA VI trophies
trophies.guide: Every meditation spot on the map must be used, and this is the only trophy on the list you can lock yourself out of: the first spots open during Chapter 1, and once the story moves past that chapter some of them are gone for good on that save. Sit down at each marker as its area opens instead of hoarding them for the end. If your counter stalls, compare your map against a full spot list before pushing the story any further.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's strand and he will point you at one specific animal. Read the habitat notes he gives, then hunt at dawn or dusk when the target is moving. A single clean shot finishes the stalk — spooking it means starting the approach over.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Three complete sets, with cards tucked into small clusters all over the state. Work one set at a time, region by region, so the remaining gaps stay visible on your map. The set only completes when its last card is picked up, not at a checkpoint in between.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: Output Lag GTA VI trophy roadmap
The Games Wiki GTA VI trophies
trophies.guide: The phone action works at tagged locations all over the map, and you need 100 distinct ones. Fire it at every new tag you pass while doing other trophies — treated as a background habit, 100 arrives without a dedicated session. The counter behind the animation is what counts, not the performance.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Fifty challenges of any mix move this counter. Challenges are the short scored objectives layered over activities, and each one registers the moment it finishes. Scan the challenge board whenever you load in and clear the easy ones first; the total climbs faster than you expect.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
sources: Output Lag GTA VI trophy roadmap
trophies.guide: Rack up four stars with your partner in tow, then cool the search without ever splitting from them. A busy strip or a station raid fills the meter fastest. Slip through alleys or take to the water, and the trophy lands the moment both of you are fully clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Pick a cluster of three shops sitting close together and rob them in one continuous spree, keeping the heat alive between stickups. Only after the third register should you break the pursuit. Walking the loop once on foot before the first robbery turns this from chaos into routine.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: Output Lag GTA VI trophy roadmap
trophies.guide: Every model you first sit behind the wheel of is logged, and the log wants 100 entries. Rotating through everyday traffic — sedans, vans, bikes, work trucks — fills it faster than hunting exotics. Open the vehicle index now and then to see which classes are still blank.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus stretches time while the meter lasts, and five enemies must drop inside one window. Stage it at a crowded gang stash or outpost, wait until targets cluster, then trigger focus only once you can see all five. Headshots feed the meter back, buying room for the last takedown.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
sources: The Games Wiki GTA VI trophies
trophies.guide: The airport does not offer departures, so improvise one: force a gate, steal an aircraft, and clear the perimeter without clearance. Arrive at speed, expect stars the moment you cross the fence, and pick your exit lane before you enter. Any improvised getaway counts as long as you leave the grounds.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Output Lag GTA VI trophy roadmap
trophies.guide: The description is the instruction: get yourself into a Rhino. Borrow one from a base or during a story beat, drive it around long enough for the moment to register, and enjoy being briefly unstoppable. Keep rocket-toting enemies at a distance while you are inside.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: One jewelry score with zero detections: watch the guard loops from outside, slip in during a gap, crack the cases quietly, and exit the way nobody patrols. Save before entering so a mid-run spotting costs seconds instead of the night. Slow movements and a suppressed sidearm do most of the work.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Five separate vault scores, each finished with a clean getaway. They appear as the state grows, so spread them across the map instead of repeating one branch. Take the cash, lose the cops completely, and only then does the vault tick onto your total.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
sources: Output Lag GTA VI trophy roadmap
trophies.guide: Stop a truck in transit, crack the rear doors, lift the cash, and vanish clean. Block the cab on a quiet stretch of road, work fast before reinforcements close in, and stage your escape vehicle in advance. The escape is part of the trophy — a busted getaway erases the whole attempt.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: The Games Wiki GTA VI trophies
trophies.guide: All 52 named areas must be entered to fill the exploration meter. Sweep the coastline and the interior systematically instead of wandering; each area flips the moment you set foot in it. Pair the sweep with stunt jumps and meditation spots so one pass of the map earns three trophies at once.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
sources: Output Lag GTA VI trophy roadmap
trophies.guide: Nine gangs run illegal operations, and each needs exactly one visit from you. The operations surface on the map once you have scouted the gang's turf, so work through them gang by gang. Volume does not matter — completing the robbery is what registers, quiet or loud.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Buy a cocktail at the Ocean Beach bar and carry it out to the rail. The trophy triggers once you are drinking inside the outlook zone, so no special timing is needed. It is a deliberate slow-down moment — a good one to do early, while you are still learning the city.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
sources: Output Lag GTA VI trophy roadmap
trophies.guide: Drive a vehicle straight through a showroom's glass and out the other side in one motion. Enter at speed, choose your exit before you enter, and ignore the security chaos — style is the entire score. The downtown flagship has the cleanest runway, but any showroom does the job.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
sources: The Games Wiki GTA VI trophies
trophies.guide: Find the Kolt & Associates alley through the activity map and roll a full follow-through frame. The trophy pops when the throw completes, not when the pins fall, so a gutter works as well as a strike. Take the ten minutes — it is a nod to an older series tradition.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This tracks a standout partnership beat from the story, so keep moving the main path and it arrives with the scene. Nothing about it can be failed and there is nothing to optimize. If you are hunting it specifically, expect it during the later chapters.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Story decisions, large and small, feed an internal counter that unlocks this at a threshold. Play naturally and it lands well before the credits; deliberately picking different dialogue and branch options only speeds it up. No single choice is required — just a lot of them.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: The Games Wiki GTA VI trophies
trophies.guide: A story beat built around a second attempt — reach that point in the narrative and the trophy follows on its own. There is no input to get wrong and no way to rush it. Let the scene play out and collect it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: The Games Wiki GTA VI trophies
trophies.guide: Something genuinely strange happens out in Leonida, and witnessing it banks this trophy. Wander the odder corners of the map, especially after dark, and never skip a marker that behaves oddly. It is tied to the story's strangest thread, so steady story progress walks you right into it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
sources: Output Lag GTA VI trophy roadmap
trophies.guide: Lean out of a moving vehicle and drop someone with a single melee swing — the bowling is in the physics, not the alley. Find a slow or stationary target, match its speed, and swing the moment you draw level. It takes a few passes to line up, so keep a save handy for painless retries.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked bills flow in from jobs; push them through your laundering contacts until a quarter million has cycled. The counter tracks the total laundered, not your cash on hand, so feed every pickup into the network as it arrives. Keep a cycle running between missions and the number clears itself.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Output Lag GTA VI trophy roadmap
trophies.guide: Clothes, weapons, vehicle parts and food all count toward the $100,000. Treat it as a by-product of gearing up rather than a shopping chore, and watch the running total in your stats menu. A few of the pricier wardrobes make surprisingly quick work of it.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: All eight garages go on the market as the story opens their regions, and each one must be bought. Purchase each as it appears so the cost spreads across the playthrough instead of landing as one giant bill. Ownership is what counts — you never need to fill them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
sources: The Games Wiki GTA VI trophies
trophies.guide: Open the Scooter Bros app while sitting in any vehicle and confirm the registration; ten distinct vehicles completes the trophy. It is a five-minute errand once you remember the app exists. Swapping between your garage cars and borrowed traffic covers the count in one session.
